_**Desis bobmarleyi**_ is an underwater spider species found in the shores of north eastern Queensland, Australia. It is known to build air chambers from silk. _D. bobmarleyi_ is named in honour of the Jamaican singer-songwriter Bob Marley.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-BaehRaveHarm17-1) As an intertidal species the name was inspired by Marley's song "High Tide or Low Tide".[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-ABCApr18-2) In April 2018 the World Register of Marine Species named it one of the top 10 most remarkable species discovered in 2017.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-ABCApr18-2) The spider is an araneomorph. _D. bobmarleyi_ is a recent discovery, which is important to note when examining its data. Additionally, because it is part of the genus _Desis_, it is considered a fully aquatic animal which is interesting because of its evolutionary history. The trnL2 and trnN genes, which are seen in marine spiders that are a part of the genus, must have experienced some kind of rearrangement that allowed for the development of its current traits._[citation needed_] The long hairs on its legs and abdomen trap an air bubble which allows it to breathe while submerged.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-ABCApr18-2)

Recent specimens of _Desis_ were collected and stored in 75% EtOH. All specimens were examined in 75% EtOH using a Leica M 205 A microscope. _**Desis bobmarleyi**_ is an underwater spider species found in the shores of north eastern Queensland, Australia. It is known to build air chambers from silk. _D. bobmarleyi_ is named in honour of the Jamaican singer-songwriter Bob Marley.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-BaehRaveHarm17-1) As an intertidal species the name was inspired by Marley's song "High Tide or Low Tide".[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-ABCApr18-2) In April 2018 the World Register of Marine Species named it one of the top 10 most remarkable species discovered in 2017.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-ABCApr18-2) The spider is an araneomorph. _D. bobmarleyi_ is a recent discovery, which is important to note when examining its data. Additionally, because it is part of the genus _Desis_, it is considered a fully aquatic animal which is interesting because of its evolutionary history. The trnL2 and trnN genes, which are seen in marine spiders that are a part of the genus, must have experienced some kind of rearrangement that allowed for the development of its current traits._[citation needed_] The long hairs on its legs and abdomen trap an air bubble which allows it to breathe while submerged.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desis_bobmarleyi#cite_note-ABCApr18-2)
